newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Tuesday:

Spokesman Joao Vale de Almeida said Commissioner Karel Van Miert would hold a news conference on state aids at 1200/1100 GMT on Wednesday, followed by Commissioners Franz Fischler and Padraig Flynn at 1230/1130 GMT on tobacco.
Vale de Almeida said the midday briefing would be put forward to 1145/1045 GMT.
In answer to questions, Vale de Almeida said it was not excluded that Commissioner Ritt Bjerregaard would hold a news conference on genetically modified maize.
He also said that the Dutch government would hold a news conference at the Council at 1600/1500 GMT on Wednesday to present the presidency work programme for the first six months of next year.

Responding to reports, Vale de Almeida denied that Commission President Jacques Santer had to appear before the EP Inquiry Committee on BSE. He said he would meet the committee after it finished its work and he was delighted to collaborate with the MEPs.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/96/1181: Diploma recognition: infringement proceedings against Greece, Spain, Portugal, France, Germany and Belgium.
- IP/96/1183: The Commission grants a five-year exemption to modified Finish roundwood trade arrangements.
- IP/96/1184: The Commission launches a call for proposals for research projects on TSE.
- IP/96/1185: From the inkwell to the keyboard: how to network European schools?
- IP/96/1186: The Commission finances the creation of 34 energy agencies in 1996.
- IP/96/1188: Fresh infringement proceedings against Italy due to the treatment of non-Italian foreign language lecturers working in Italian universities.
- Speech/96/334: Speech by Commissioner Yves-Thibault de Silguy on the results of the Dublin European Council.
- Conclusions of the Dublin European Council.
- Eurostat news release No 80/96: EU unemployment: 10.9% in October.
- Eurostat statistics in focus; energy and industry No 1996-35: Electricity prices for EU households on 1 July, 1996: downward trend.
- Main points in the agenda of 18 December's weekly Commission meeting.
